title: peabiru: multimodal routing on OpenStreetMap and GTFS networks
description: peabiru computes travel-time matrices and accessibility on multimodal transport networks (walk, bicycle, car and public transport) built from OpenStreetMap extracts and GTFS feeds. Its routing engine is a Rust port of Conveyal's R5 and needs no Java runtime. The same engine is distributed as the Rust crate peabiru-core and as the R and Python packages peabiru.
